meta.name: Pear (pear.no) -> Recolte transfer
references: https://pear.no/ (browsed live, 8 scroll positions, computed styles read)
meta.note: Pear supplies rhythm, pacing and typographic contrast. Colour is NOT taken from Pear: it is measured from the Recolte cafe footage with design-dna/scripts/measure-colors.mjs.

accent.role: raw bronze: one hue, two lightnesses keyed to ground (page hard-cuts light/dark)

neutral.usage: ink-soft on linen is #5e4b3c; ink-soft on graphite is #c9b8a8

color.override_justification: Linen/espresso/bronze is a banned default family in design-taste, but the brief names these colours explicitly and every value here is measured from the venue itself.

recolte.mono: Geist Mono 400, lower-case, tabular: only for real data (altitude, coordinates, temperature, grams, time)

layout.pear_principle: type anchored to a corner of the image, never centred over it; image owns the frame

shape.radius: 0 on media and panels; arch (semicircular top) is the single shape motif; 999px only on small toggles

elevation.approach: no shadows on content; depth from overlap, scale and blur

pear_observed: scenes resolve from blur to sharp

components.header: thin, transparent, ink flips with the ground
components.buttons: text + hairline underline; one filled bronze CTA label used everywhere: Start a subscription

design_style.aesthetic: architectural hospitality editorial: quiet, warm, tactile, slow
design_style.visual_language: arches from the cafe's clay panels, linen paper, stone, bronze hardware
design_style.composition: image first; typography sits in the corners the footage leaves empty; hard cuts between chapter grounds
design_style.imagery: only the supplied footage and stills of the real venue
design_style.interaction_feel: weighted, unhurried, everything interpolates toward the hand
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: plain, warm, specific. Real coffees, real notes, real address.

scroll_effects.parallax: hero planes: footage 0.88x scale settle, arch frame fastest, type 1x, light wash 0.5x
scroll_effects.scroll_triggered_animations: scene copy keyed to the decoded video time, not to a percentage
scroll_effects.scroll_morphing: arch window opens to full bleed (clip-path inset with elliptical radius)

visual_effects.cursor_effects: fine-pointer ring that grows over controls; native cursor kept on inputs
visual_effects.image_effects: grain overlay that rises with scroll velocity
visual_effects.svg_animations: roast-curve instrument drawn by scroll (signature move)
visual_effects.composite_notes: Pear's WebGL halftone/blur transitions are intentionally not reproduced.
